mapper.select: SELECT c.id, COALESCE(p.merchant_id, c.merchant_id, 1) AS merchant_id, COALESCE(m.merchant_name, '默认店铺') AS merchant_name, c.product_id, c.sku_id, p.product_name, p.main_image, s.sku_code AS spec_name, c.sku_specs, s.price, s.original_price, c.quantity, s.stock, c.selected FROM biz_cart c LEFT JOIN biz_product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN biz_product_sku s ON c.sku_id = s.id LEFT JOIN biz_merchant m ON COALESCE(p.merchant_id, c.merchant_id) = m.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
